item.title: Horsham Golf enters Christmas undefeated
item.description: Several tight matches were played out in round 11 of the Wimmera Lawn Bowls division one pennant competition, with Horsham Golf finishing the calendar year undefeated.At Horsham Golf Bowls Club, the home side won two out of three rinks to overcome Sunnyside in a hard-fought 66-61 encounter. item.title: Festival success for BGLC
item.description: A grassroots connection with the river, the land, and each other was the highlight of the Wotjobaluk Festival, celebrating the 20-year milestone of Native Title recognition on Saturday, December 13.A grassroots connection with the river, the land, and each other was the highlight of the Wotjobaluk Festival, celebrating the 20-year milestone of Native Title recognition on Saturday, December 13.The festival was held on the riverbank at Horseshoe Bend campgrounds and attracted more than 500 people.
